Rajiv — thanks, this is helpful context. I pushed an initial MAP draft into the thread and attached a short eval-matrix and cost sketch. High level thoughts:

1) Recommended decision path (minimal friction -> fastest time to value):
   - Phase A (2 weeks): Hosted PoC (latency profiling, prefix caching, inference quality baseline).
   - Phase B (3–4 weeks): Dedicated pilot if you need sustained throughput and tighter SLOs; reserved capacity pricing applies.
   - Phase C (variable): Private (VPC/on-prem) for full data isolation — requires infra lock and legal (4–8+ weeks).

2) What we included in the MAP draft: evaluation artifacts (test suite links), acceptance thresholds (p50/p95 latencies, token cost targets), who signs each gate (Eng, Security, Procurement), and the recommended rollback conditions.

I attached: Calyx_MAP_v1.xlsx and a short eval-matrix-hosting.pdf. Karthik — can you confirm the Dedicated SLA numbers I used in tab 2? Vanessa — can you flag any legal/contract lead time PKG?

Cheers,

- Dedicated sample: 4x A100-class reserved nodes (equivalent throughput at your model mix) -> projected baseline cost ~ $45k/mo (committed) vs Hosted variable ~$0.005/token effective at 10M tokens (~$50k/mo) before committed discount. Exact depends on seq lengths and KV-cache hit rates.

- Private/VPC: network egress controls and KMS integration are straightforward; full on-prem requires air-gap packaging and ~6–10 week delivery (ops + legal).
